1.title: Chip stocks slide in US and Asia as AI jitters rattle investors
1.summary: Trading on South Korea's Kospi index was paused temporarily on Tuesday morning after slumping by 8%.

2.title: Trump Backs New Iran Talks but It’s Unclear What He Hopes to Achieve This Time
2.summary: Iran denied President Trump’s claim that it wants to talk, and gave no sign that it would make concessions or speak directly with U.S. officials.

3.title: Graham to Be Honored at Funeral Services This Week. Here’s How to Watch.
3.summary: Closed ceremonies for the Republican senator, a stalwart ally of President Trump, will be held in Washington on Tuesday before a procession and public funeral in South Carolina the next day.

4.title: People trapped inside Japan shopping centre after earthquake
4.summary: Some reports say there was an explosion at the Aeon Mall in Kumamoto, following the magnitude 7.1 earthquake.

5.title: Live Updates: 6.8-Magnitude Earthquake Strikes Japan
5.summary: Fires and injuries were reported after the quake in the southwestern prefecture of Kumamoto, according to Japan’s state broadcaster. A tsunami warning was lifted.

6.title: Fresh Clashes Erupt in Pakistani Kashmir on First Day of Contested Vote
6.summary: Dozens have died in recent weeks ahead of a weekslong regional election, officials said. A banned civil rights group said supporters died in conflicts with the police.
